interaction_identity_check.claim: the two algebraic forms of the interaction are the same linear functional of the four cells and must agree to floating-point tolerance; a disagreement means a cell or a sign is wrong in this implementation
interaction_identity_check.tolerance_rule: atol 1e-12 + rtol 1e-12 * max |cell value| for that metric

interaction_solver_x_geometry.null_hypothesis: the two factors are additive: the effect of solver is the same at both levels of geometry
interaction_solver_x_geometry.positive_means: the effect of solver is MORE POSITIVE when geometry is on than when it is off; equivalently the effect of geometry is more positive when solver is on

main_effect_geometry.null_hypothesis: geometry has no average effect across the levels of solver
main_effect_geometry.positive_means: averaged over both levels of solver, turning geometry on RAISES the metric

uncertainty.protections: Point contact/completion loss <= .02; absence of nominal significant FS/HS-frame harm in registered contrasts; not equivalence

strata_note: Existing optimizer-prefixed duplicate telemetry is retained in the full run artifact analysis/strata.json; all diagnostic means remain above.
closure_audit_field_note: recorded_snapshot_audit.accepted_states counts all recorded source/current/final states, including the final repeated state of an exhausted search; accepted_updates is the distinct update count.
decision: Retain Armijo as the passing pilot solver and reconstruction as the comparison anchor; full Phase 2, useful HSI supervision, realism and learned training remain open.
limitations: Compared with A01-increment, HS/OS mean and maximum depths worsen at both nominal units; the registered pilot gate did not require retaining those gains.
A01 FS and HS-frame increases versus reconstruction remain unresolved, not equivalent.
A01 HS mean improvement versus reconstruction is about 3% and significant only at the scene unit; full Phase 2 is open.
The 50 positive-scene solves that exhaust line search after descent and 167 reaching iteration budget do not establish convergence.

Seven newly invalid object-point observations occur in four corrections; one has a nonzero scene-energy drop on the newly invalid point. Query validity and geometric grid bounds differ near lower edges.
Sparse optimization energies and native mesh-SDF outcomes differ. All solver shadows use same-source inputs and do not represent shadow closed-loop native rollouts.
Finite-sample pilot confidence intervals use seed 42 and only four scene units; there is no cross-seed or full-benchmark claim.
Eight-lane instrumented runtime includes diagnostic derivatives/shadows and brief GPU7 contention from initial verification; it is not isolated production latency.
next_action: Read-only review of A01 scene-reference switching, grid validity and 50 positive-scene searches that exhaust after descent using saved states; propose one next experiment before a new workload or mechanism.
